notes.title: 🌟20 NEW Ducks!
notes.content:
[h3]Among the new ducks you can find:[/h3]

[list]
[*] +2 classified
[*] +4 exotic
[*] +2 mythic
[*] +3 rare
[*] +3 uncommon
[*] +5 standard
[/list]

... and [b]1 unique[/b] Duck awarded to only 5 community members during the last giveaway!

[url=https://discord.gg/qmnUJ2cBVu]Join our discord[/url] for updates, events, and more giveaways with exclusive ducks!

[h3]Reminder [/h3]
Some of the week 1 ducks are [b]leaving the pond in 3 days[/b], meaning they will no longer drop😢

On the bright side, and in light of our new arrivals, we have decided to [b]extend the 3x loot event[/b] until then.
